title: ChemInform Abstract: Kroehnkite‐Type Na<sub>2</sub>Fe(SO<sub>4</sub>)<sub>2</sub>·2H<sub>2</sub>O as a Novel 3.25 V Insertion Compound for Na‐Ion Batteries.
abstract: AbstractThe title compound is prepared by drying an aqueous solution of Na2SO4, FeSO4, and an optional addition of ascorbic acid at 70—80 °C, followed by further drying of the obtained white powder at 70 °C for 1 h.
